Name: Busty Bachelorettes
Author: Sandunky
Description:
[center][b][u]Overview:[/u][/b]

Have you ever wanted every adult inhabitant of Stardew Valley to have some huge honkers? Well, this is the mod for you! The goal is to make everybody a girl, with bigger boobs and revealing clothing. And yes, this includes the males.

Comes in two flavors: High resolution and Low resolution. High resolution was made natively at 320x320 pixels. High resolution requires Portraiture, no exceptions. Low resolution was made at 64x64 pixels, which is the same resolution that the vanilla portraits are. You can use them with Portraiture or Content Patcher. The Content Patcher install for Low resolution will replace vanilla’s portraits with the new ones from this mod. If you want to keep the vanilla portraits, stick with the Portraiture version.

Further down the road, the mod will include the sprites in the world. At the moment, only Abigail’s is finished and included. More to come later, I promise!

As of now, only the bachelorettes have been done. The plan is to make all of the natural females busty and revealing first. Then I’ll genderbend the males and give them the same treatment. I’ll be making updates in phases, so you’ll get whole groups at once.

For Jas and Vincent, I’ll be doing a separate release that’s far more safe for work, and they’ll be included there. That version will be the portraits done in my style, for consistency sake. So, for example, if you don’t want to genderbend the males, there will be the option to keep them male in that pack. Or if you just like my style and wish there weren’t massive boobs in your face, that’ll be for you too.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]SMAPI (Ver. 3.6.0)

[*]Content Patcher (Ver. 1.16) - Required for character sprites, which have to be included or SMAPI yells at me.

[*]Portraiture (and all that requires) - Optional, but recommended.

[/list]
[b][u]Install Options:[/u][/b]

There are multiple files for you to download. The files will change as this mod gets updated. The options at the moment are:
[list]
[*]High Res Only - Only the high resolution portraits.
[*]Low Res Content Patcher Only - Only the low resolution portraits, set to replace the vanilla portraits to be used as the default.
[*]Low Res Portraiture Only - Only the low resolution portraits, set up for Portraiture. 
[*]Portraiture + Content Patcher - A mix of high resolution and low resolution. Uses Content Patcher to replace the vanilla portraits with the low resolution portraits, while using Portraiture to let you switch to the high resolution portraits. This is the recommended installation.
[*]Portraiture Only - High and low resolution portraits both set up for Portraiture.
[/list]
[b][i]IMPORTANT: MAKE SURE YOU ONLY INSTALL ONE AT A TIME. DON’T INSTALL THE HIGH RES FILES AND THEN THE SEPARATE LOW RES CONTENT PATCHER FILES. THIS WILL BREAK THE MOD IN HALF.[/i][/b]

[b][u]Installation Instructions:
[/u][/b][color=#ffff00][i]VERY IMPORTANT! [/i]Due to my desire to make this mod modular, I had to rename some of the folders for compatibility! If updating from 1.0.1 to 1.1.0, PLEASE find the file named "Low Res CP" in your mods folder and delete it first thing! Also, remove "Busty Bachelorettes High Res" and/or "Busty Bachelorettes Low Res" from your Portraiture folder. Thank you![/color]

[list=1]
[*]Go to your game directory, where the game’s exe is located.

[*]Install all of the requirements for which sets you want (SMAPI, Portraiture, Content Patcher)

[*]Extract the “Mods” folder from the zip files to your game directory.

[*]Run SMAPI. If everything was done correctly, then it should load no problem.

[/list]
[b][u]Uninstalling:
[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Go into your mods folder in your game directory.

[*]If you use Portraiture, go to the Portraiture folder, then to the Portraits folder. Find “Sandunky High Res” and/or “Sandunky Low Res” and delete them. Also delete "BB World Sprites"

[*]For Content Patcher, simply find “BB Low Res CP” in your Mods folder. Delete that folder.

[/list][u][b]Changelog:
[/b][/u]Version 1.1.0: Updated for 1.5. Added beach portraits for the bachelorettes, and reworked the world sprites for Abigail and Emily. Also did their beach world sprites. Plus, a preview of phase 2: Townie Tatas.
Version 1.0.1: Added Emily's world sprite.
Version 1.0.0: Initial release. High and low res portraits for all six ladies and world sprite for Abigail.[/center]
